title: Freiburg — City Trees
description: 45,413 registered public trees reveal Freiburg’s planting patterns, coloured by botanical genus against a subtle street network.

title: Germany’s Traffic Intensity
description: Germany’s motorways and major roads glow in seven classes of modelled daily vehicle traffic, revealing the busiest estimated corridors.

title: Munich — Cadastral Mosaic
description: 29,601 cadastral footprints form a colourful portrait of central Munich, with the Isar and parks in cream.

title: Almería in pastel red
description: A vintage-inspired portrait of Almería, tracing its streets, buildings and harbour in pastel red and warm cream.
